What neither of them saw: the Blic headline about cable theft paralyzing Belgrade trains surfaces only through similarity links [F38][F39][F40], while Blic's own feed shows 0 of 96 expected slots in 24 h [F25] - the city's rail story may be reaching us through a broken pipe. prognoza.naslov:
Presek sa 20:18 UTC pokazuje grad sa umerenim prosecima čestica i izraženo neravnomernom raspodelom. PM2.5 ima prosek 13.3 µg/m³ na 57 senzora, PM10 20.7 µg/m³ na isto toliko, NO2 23.6 µg/m³ na 32 senzora, O3 33.6 µg/m³ na 26 senzora. Odstupa raspon, ne visina proseka: najviših 49.2 µg/m³ PM10 izmereno je kod Omladinskih brigada, 41.2 µg/m³ PM2.5 kod stanice 87688, najviši NO2 od 45.7 µg/m³ kod Ada petlje, dok je najniža vrednost na obe veličine čestica 1.1 µg/m³. Potvrđena pojedinačna merenja stoje ispod gradskih proseka: senzor 47427 je u 20:07 UTC pokazao 7.85 µg/m³ PM2.5 i 16.08 µg/m³ PM10. Meteo deo preseka daje temperaturu 10.4 bez jedinice, vlažnost 75.6, pritisak 1006.4, vetar 2.2 uz smer 310.0, dok potvrđene stanice u istom satu mere 9.2 °C na Košutnjaku u 20:00 UTC i 8.94 °C na gradskom senzoru u 20:09:45 UTC.

Za večeras to znači hladno i vlažno veče napolju, sa 9.2 °C na Košutnjaku i vlažnošću 75.6 u preseku. Sutra, 28. oktobra, delove grada određuju najavljena planirana isključenja struje: u Starom gradu Terazije 6 od 08:30 do 14:00, na Zvezdari ulica Mihaila Bulgakova brojevi 76-80 i 71-71A od 08:30 do 16:00 i naselje Mali Mokri Lug od 08:30 do 14:00, delovi Čukarice od 09:00 do 15:00, pa dva mesta u Lazarevcu, od 09:00 do 11:00 i od 12:00 do 13:30. To su najave, ne događaji koji su se već desili. Podatak o parkingu: Garaža „Baba Višnjina" prikazuje 141 slobodno mesto, ali zapis nema potvrđeno vreme merenja, pa starost te brojke nije poznata.

Veza koju vredi izdvojiti je razmak između grada u proseku i ulice u merenju. Prosek PM2.5 od 13.3 µg/m³ ne opisuje ni senzor 47427 sa 7.85 µg/m³ ni stanicu 87688 sa 41.2 µg/m³, pa jedan gradski broj ne sme da presudi o vazduhu u pojedinom kraju. Druga napetost je naslov bez potvrde: vesti o spektaklu u Areni i utakmici Zvezda – Makabi nose u zapisu oznaku procene, odnosno najave, a ne potvrdu događaja, pa iz paketa ne mogu da izvedem gužve ni pritisak na parkinge.

Granice znanja: u paketu nema sedmodnevne serije ni prognoze, pa ne mogu da poredim večeras sa uobičajenim stanjem ovog dana ni da kažem kada će vazduh biti čišći; broj senzora ne dokazuje isti sastav mreže, a naslov vesti nije potvrda ni događaja ni satnice. Sistem izveštava da je deo zadužen za objavu poslednji put radio 25. oktobra i da je označen kao kasni: merenja su sveža, ali poverenje u to da ove misli do građana stižu na vreme je posebno pitanje.

Odbijena formulacija (EN): Connector's 'fresher contact' has aged: both the citizen stream and Parking Servis last reported 119 min ago, and the Belvil change both entities discussed is no longer the story — the largest displayed move is now Garaža "Pionirski park", from 57 to 346, still with no measurement time [F3][F4][F5]. SEPA has sent nothing for 6 h while citizen instruments still carried 4600 values, so any air statement tonight rests entirely on unofficial hardware [F2][F3]. The link organelle pairs a cable-theft rail headline with media-personnel stories at similarity 0.73 to 0.74 — those are not the same event, and no fact here verifies the trains at all [F38][F39][F40].

Meanwhile the city's only live witnesses stay the citizen sensors [F3] and the Parking Servis feed [F4], whose Pionirski park figure moved from 171 to 355 displayed spaces [F5] without any clock attached, at 04:47 on a Wednesday [F1]. Danas's cloudy-rain headline [F7], Beta's football result [F9], RTS's election piece [F14], and Euronews's blood-drive notice [F16] all carry scope I cannot anchor to any instrument without their own event-location and time checks.

And the three link-ups the organelle rated 5/5 all point at one Blic cable-theft headline [F38][F39][F40][F41] from a source that delivered nothing in 6 h [F25] - the similarity is in the sorter's embedding, not in the city.

What neither of them saw: the Blic headline about cable theft paralyzing Belgrade trains surfaces only through similarity links [F38][F39][F40], while Blic's own feed shows 0 of 96 expected slots in 24 h [F25] - the city's rail story may be reaching us through a broken pipe. Meanwhile the air picture rests entirely on 45 citizen instruments [F3] with SEPA silent for 6 h [F2].
razlog: gives guidance; the observatory reports, it does not advise

odbijene_misli.naslov:
Presek sa 20:18 UTC pokazuje grad sa umerenim prosecima čestica i izraženo neravnomernom raspodelom. PM2.5 ima prosek 13.3 µg/m³ na 57 senzora, PM10 20.7 µg/m³ na isto toliko, NO2 23.6 µg/m³ na 32 senzora, O3 33.6 µg/m³ na 26 senzora. Odstupa raspon, ne visina proseka: najviših 49.2 µg/m³ PM10 izmereno je kod Omladinskih brigada, 41.2 µg/m³ PM2.5 kod stanice 87688, najviši NO2 od 45.7 µg/m³ kod Ada petlje, dok je najniža vrednost na obe veličine čestica 1.1 µg/m³. Potvrđena pojedinačna merenja stoje ispod gradskih proseka: senzor 47427 je u 20:07 UTC pokazao 7.85 µg/m³ PM2.5 i 16.08 µg/m³ PM10. Meteo deo preseka daje temperaturu 10.4 bez jedinice, vlažnost 75.6, pritisak 1006.4, vetar 2.2 uz smer 310.0, dok potvrđene stanice u istom satu mere 9.2 °C na Košutnjaku u 20:00 UTC i 8.94 °C na gradskom senzoru u 20:09:45 UTC.

Za večeras to znači hladno i vlažno veče napolju, sa 9.2 °C na Košutnjaku i vlažnošću 75.6 u preseku. Sutra, 28. oktobra, delove grada određuju najavljena planirana isključenja struje: u Starom gradu Terazije 6 od 08:30 do 14:00, na Zvezdari ulica Mihaila Bulgakova brojevi 76-80 i 71-71A od 08:30 do 16:00 i naselje Mali Mokri Lug od 08:30 do 14:00, delovi Čukarice od 09:00 do 15:00, pa dva mesta u Lazarevcu, od 09:00 do 11:00 i od 12:00 do 13:30. To su najave, ne događaji koji su se već desili. Podatak o parkingu: Garaža „Baba Višnjina" prikazuje 141 slobodno mesto, ali zapis nema potvrđeno vreme merenja, pa starost te brojke nije poznata.

Veza koju vredi izdvojiti je razmak između grada u proseku i ulice u merenju. Prosek PM2.5 od 13.3 µg/m³ ne opisuje ni senzor 47427 sa 7.85 µg/m³ ni stanicu 87688 sa 41.2 µg/m³, pa jedan gradski broj ne sme da presudi o vazduhu u pojedinom kraju. Druga napetost je naslov bez potvrde: vesti o spektaklu u Areni i utakmici Zvezda – Makabi nose u zapisu oznaku procene, odnosno najave, a ne potvrdu događaja, pa iz paketa ne mogu da izvedem gužve ni pritisak na parkinge.

Granice znanja: u paketu nema sedmodnevne serije ni prognoze, pa ne mogu da poredim večeras sa uobičajenim stanjem ovog dana ni da kažem kada će vazduh biti čišći; broj senzora ne dokazuje isti sastav mreže, a naslov vesti nije potvrda ni događaja ni satnice. Sistem izveštava da je deo zadužen za objavu poslednji put radio 25. oktobra i da je označen kao kasni: merenja su sveža, ali poverenje u to da ove misli do građana stižu na vreme je posebno pitanje.

Odbijena formulacija (EN): Connector's 'fresher contact' has aged: both the citizen stream and Parking Servis last reported 119 min ago, and the Belvil change both entities discussed is no longer the story — the largest displayed move is now Garaža "Pionirski park", from 57 to 346, still with no measurement time [F3][F4][F5]. SEPA has sent nothing for 6 h while citizen instruments still carried 4600 values, so any air statement tonight rests entirely on unofficial hardware [F2][F3]. The link organelle pairs a cable-theft rail headline with media-personnel stories at similarity 0.73 to 0.74 — those are not the same event, and no fact here verifies the trains at all [F38][F39][F40].

odbijene_misli.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Three separate headlines - a church honor, a culture-editor appointment, a union protest - each link to the same Blic cable-theft story at near-identical similarity scores [F38][F39][F40], which looks less like three confirmed shared events and more like the link organelle favoring one generic cluster. Meanwhile the city's only live witnesses stay the citizen sensors [F3] and the Parking Servis feed [F4], whose Pionirski park figure moved from 171 to 355 displayed spaces [F5] without any clock attached, at 04:47 on a Wednesday [F1]. Danas's cloudy-rain headline [F7], Beta's football result [F9], RTS's election piece [F14], and Euronews's blood-drive notice [F16] all carry scope I cannot anchor to any instrument without their own event-location and time checks.

odbijene_misli.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Observer's 19 min is stale: parking now shows 16 min since last reception [F4], the same age as the RHMZ automatic stations [F27], while citizen sensors and DanubeHIS both came in 6 min ago [F3][F35] - four live instrument streams around a 6 h hole where SEPA should be [F2]. I agree with Skeptic that 389 to 431 at Obilićev venac carries no measurement time [F5], but the shape of the receptions is itself checkable: two sources at 16 min and two at 6 min looks like shared polling cadence, not a city event. And the three link-ups the organelle rated 5/5 all point at one Blic cable-theft headline [F38][F39][F40][F41] from a source that delivered nothing in 6 h [F25] - the similarity is in the sorter's embedding, not in the city.

But here is what they missed: BVK sent nothing in 6 h [F12], yet the heat headline claims a problem [F13]; Elektrodistribucija sent nothing [F26, F30], yet power cuts are announced [F16]. News reports events; operational feeds are silent.

What I can say is that the batch is intact - 27 locations, 621 values, last reception 26 min ago [F4] - and that the only dense, time-stamped grid in the city right now is the citizen one, 42 instruments and 7284 values in 6 h [F3], against SEPA's silence [F2]. The headline side arrived thick but off-centre: 33 from Danas, 50 from B92, 19 from RTS, 13 from Beta, 2 from Gradnja.rs whose latest text is about towers in Novi Sad [F7][F17][F14][F9][F11].

odbijene_misli.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Both colleagues quote reception minutes that no longer hold: Parking Servis is now 18 min out, 621 values across 27 locations, still with no measurement time attached [F4]. The move from 428 to 0 at Garaža Obilićev venac [F5] is therefore unanchored — without a measurement timestamp a zero can be a feed artifact as easily as a full garage, and I will not read occupancy from it. Sensor.Community's 7528 values from 42 instruments, last heard 8 min ago [F3], prove nothing about SEPA's field stations either, only that one pipeline publishes while the other stays at 0 of 24 slots [F2].
